description:
Anonymised respondent-level rows from the Male Confidence Index 2025, for your own analysis.

    Each row has row_id, the requested columns and Weight (always use it). Page with offset and
    next_offset. Rows are anonymised (no identifiers, shuffled, free text redacted) and carry only gender,
    age band and state as demographics (Tasmania, ACT and NT grouped; small groups withheld). For splits
    by other demographics use mci_results or mci_scores.

columns.description: Variable ids or question groups to include, e.g. ["S1", "age_group", "Q11", "Male_Confidence_Index"]. Default: gender, age band, state, index and domain scores. Demographics other than gender, age band and state (exact age, region, education, employment, household, housing, sexuality, income) are not available at row level: use mci_results for those.
columns.title: Columns

filter.description: Optional {variable: value} map restricting rows, e.g. {"gender": "Male", "state": "Victoria"}. Filters on gender, age band, state or any survey answer; a filter matching fewer than 30 respondents is refused.
filter.title: Filter

labels.description: True returns answer labels (default). False returns numeric codes, which are smaller; decode them with mci_questions.
labels.title: Labels

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200. Default 50. Pages are capped at about 60kB.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Index of the first row to return, for paging. Pass the previous page's next_offset. Default 0.
offset.title: Offset

name: mci_rows
title: Male Confidence Index: respondent rows
